subject: Upfront credits amortization, VAT routing & wiring plan
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Nora Klein <nora.klein@bluejar.com>, Bluejar Payables <payables@bluejar.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Upfront credits amortization, VAT routing & wiring plan

Hi Nora / Bluejar AP team —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion, here’s a proposed way to handle the $200,000 annual prepay (HB-2026-0427) so it works with your ERP and avoids tax reclassification problems on your side:   

1) Invoicing cadence: Redwood will issue four quarterly invoices that amortize the prepaid credit across the year. The first invoice will be dated at receipt of funds. Each invoice will include a line-item for the credit amortization and a running drawdown balance.

2) VAT / tax handling: For US billing there’s no VAT; for any EU-sourced usage we will issue country-specific VAT invoices. Please confirm the VAT ID to which Bluejar would like EU invoices sent.

3) Banking / wiring: I’ve attached our wire instructions (Redwood_wire_instructions_Marissa.pdf). Marissa from Finance is copied to confirm the beneficiary details and turnaround time.

4) PO & Docs: If you can return a signed PO (I attached a draft below) and sign the short amendment via DocuSign (link in the follow-up), we’ll finalize the first invoice.

Attachments: Redwood_invoicing_schedule_Q4-2026.xlsx (amortization ladder + sample invoice), prepay-drawdown-ledger-template.csv

Next steps: Please confirm (a) preferred invoice recipient & VAT ID, (b) whether Bluejar prefers a single consolidated invoice each quarter or three line-items (amortization + usage adjustments), and (c) expected payment ETA once PO is issued.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if useful.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com
+1 415 555 0123
From: Nora Klein <nora.klein@bluejar.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Bluejar Payables <payables@bluejar.com>, Owen Park <owen.park@bluejar.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upfront credits amortization, VAT routing & wiring plan

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few clarifications from our AP/CFO side:  

- PO: We need the Redwood customer legal name and invoice remit-to address on our PO template (attached as Bluejar_PO_template.pdf). Can you confirm Redwood’s remit address and the W-9 tax name?
- ERP format: Our AP team prefers the drawdown ledger as a CSV with columns: invoice_date, invoice_number, gross_amount, vat_amount, net_amount, credit_applied, remaining_balance. Can you supply the ledger in that format?
- VAT: Bluejar’s EU VAT ID is GB987654321. We expect separate VAT invoices for any EU-sourced usage; please confirm Redwood will mark VAT at the invoice line level.
- Banking: Once we receive a pro forma invoice with wired bank details we will route to payables. For international transfers we need the SWIFT and an intermediary bank if applicable.

We can sign the PO once Redwood confirms the invoice format and provides the pro forma first invoice. Also copying Owen (CFO) for visibility.

Best,
Nora Klein
Head of Procurement | Bluejar Analytics
Nora.Klein@bluejar.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Nora Klein <nora.klein@bluejar.com>, Bluejar Payables <payables@bluejar.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upfront credits amortization, VAT routing & wiring plan

Hi Nora —

Thanks for the quick feedback. I’m Marissa on Redwood Finance — copying Lauren from Legal for the amendment question. To address your items:  

- Remit name / W-9: Redwood Inference, Inc.; remit address: 125 Market St, Suite 700, San Francisco, CA 94105. W-9 is attached on request — I can email a PDF if you prefer.
- CSV ledger: Attached is a CSV template (prepay-drawdown-ledger-template.csv) formatted to your columns. We will populate that for each quarterly invoice and include it as an exportable file on the invoice PDF.
- VAT handling: Confirmed — we will issue VAT at the line level for any EU-billed usage and deliver VAT invoices to the GB987654321 recipient/email you specify. For US invoices VAT will be zero and the VAT field will be present as 0.00.
- Banking / SWIFT: Please see attached Redwood_wire_instructions_Marissa.pdf (includes SWIFT, IBAN where applicable, and intermediary routing notes). For Bluejar specifically, our bank requires beneficiary name + invoice reference on the wire; include the invoice number HB-2026-0427-INV1.

DocuSign: We prepared a short amendment to the MSA to document amortization and invoice cadence (no change to pricing or SLAs). Here is the signing link once you confirm: https://www.docusign.net/embeddedSigning?token=abc123-docusign  (one signature from Bluejar Procurement is sufficient).

We’ll generate a pro forma invoice the moment we have: signed PO, signed DocuSign amendment, and confirmation of the remit email for VAT copies (payables@bluejar.com?). Expected payment due date = 30 days from invoice date unless you need an alternate term.

Attachment list: Redwood_wire_instructions_Marissa.pdf, prepay-drawdown-ledger-template.csv

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>

Date: 2026-10-16T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upfront credits amortization, VAT routing & wiring plan

Great — thanks Nora / Owen. To recap next steps so we have a single checklist:  

- Bluejar: return signed PO (use attached template) and sign the DocuSign amendment (link above).
- Redwood: Marissa will produce pro forma HB-2026-0427-INV1 and the CSV drawdown ledger; Diego will send the invoice and wire reference.
- AP instructions: Bluejar to send payment to Redwood per attached wire instructions and include invoice ref HB-2026-0427-INV1 in the transfer notes.

I’ve attached a sample amortization ladder in Redwood_invoicing_schedule_Q4-2026.xlsx — it shows:  
  * Invoice 1 (at receipt of funds) — $50,000 amortization credit applied, remaining credit $150,000
  * Subsequent quarterly invoices to follow the same pattern with usage adjustments shown as separate lines

If everything looks good I’ll wait for the signed PO and DocuSign and we’ll push the pro forma through finance the same day. Happy to set a 20-min call to walk Owen through the amortization if helpful.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
